conflicts.description: admin-cli spec adds boredom_eligible and boredom_priority fields to activity_template. The boredom detection spec expects these fields to exist for filtering eligible templates.
conflicts.impact: Boredom system will fail to filter templates if migration not applied before boredom activities execute

resolution.action: Schema migration 008-boredom-eligibility.surql must be applied before boredom system uses new filtering logic
resolution.implementation: Add migration to deployment checklist and schema initialization

mitigationSteps: Apply migration: python -m server.cli db init-schema --schema-file sql/migrations/008-boredom-eligibility.surql
Verify fields exist: SELECT boredom_eligible FROM activity_template LIMIT 1
Update boredom API endpoint to use new fields

conflicts.description: admin-cli spec expects boredom API to filter by boredom_eligible=true. Current boredom detection spec queries all templates without this filter.
conflicts.impact: Boredom system may select templates not marked as boredom-eligible, potentially executing inappropriate activities

resolution.action: Update server/routes/activity.py metabob_fetch_boredom_activities endpoint to add WHERE boredom_eligible=true filter
resolution.implementation: Modify query in activity.py:524 (approximately) to filter templates
resolution.code: query = 'SELECT * FROM activity_template WHERE boredom_eligible = true AND boredom_priority >= $threshold ORDER BY boredom_priority DESC LIMIT $limit'

mitigationSteps: Add boredom_eligible filter to SurrealDB query
Test endpoint returns only eligible templates
Update BoredomManager to use priority field
